hints.title: First Row Reference
hints.text: Column flips needed to clear row zero uniquely determine which columns must be flipped.

hints.title: Row Agreement Invariant
hints.text: With column operations fixed, every subsequent row can be cleared if and only if it is either identical to or inverted from row zero.

hints.title: Direct Parity Scan
hints.text: Iterate through each row and verify that it matches row zero completely or is its exact complement.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(M * N) comparison against base row pattern
complexity.notes: Every row must be either identical to row 0 or the bitwise inversion of row 0.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating combinations of 2^(M + N) flips is exponential and redundant.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Row equality and inversion checking verifies reachability in linear grid time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that column operations fix row 0, requiring other rows to match or invert.
